{{Short description|none}}
The '''2025 Copa Libertadores final stages''' were played from 12 August to 29 November 2025.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/calendario-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Protegido: Calendario de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=18 September 2024|access-date=1 November 2024|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lavoz.com.ar/deportes/futbol/conmebol-publico-el-calendario-2025-cuando-arranca-la-copa-libertadores-para-talleres/|title=Conmebol publicó el calendario 2025: cuándo arranca la Copa Libertadores para Talleres|trans-title=Conmebol published the 2025 calendar: when does the Copa Libertadores start for Talleres?|publisher=[[La Voz del Interior]]|date=13 December 2024|access-date=15 December 2024|language=es}}</ref> A total of 16 teams competed in the final stages deciding the champions of the [[2025 Copa Libertadores]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CL-2025-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Libertadores 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores Clubs Handbook|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=12 December 2024|access-date=16 December 2024}}</ref> with the final played at [[Estadio Monumental "U"|Estadio Monumental]] in [[Lima]], Peru.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/conmebol-libertadores/articles-video/conmebol-announced-lima-as-host-city-for-the-2025-copa-libertadores-final-2025-04-28|title=CONMEBOL announced Lima as host city for the 2025 Copa Libertadores Final|publisher=[[beIN Sports (American TV channel)|BeIN Sports]]|date=28 April 2025|access-date=15 May 2025}}</ref><ref name="Final stadium">{{cite web|url=https://www.infobae.com/deportes/2025/08/11/la-conmebol-confirmo-el-estadio-donde-se-jugara-la-final-de-la-libertadores-2025/ |title=La Conmebol confirmó el estadio donde se jugará la final de ==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams played a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2). If tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] would not be played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.3).
*The final was played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.3.5). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] would be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 2 June 2025, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]) at the CONMEBOL headquarters in [[Luque]], Paraguay.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/sorteo-de-octavos-de-final-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Sorteo de Octavos de Final de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana – 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana Round of 16 draw|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=19 May 2025|access-date=19 May 2025|language=es}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a group winner (Pot 1) and a group runner-up (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).<ref name="regulations"/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-de-sorteo-para-octavos-de-final-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Pautas de sorteo para Octavos de Final de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|trans-title=Draw guidelines for the Round of 16 of the 2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=21 May 2025|access-date=29 May 2025}}</ref><section end=Draw />

==Quarter-finals==
===Summary===
The first legs were played on 16–18 September, and the second legs were played on 23–25 September 2025.<ref name="QF fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fixture-de-cuartos-de-final-para-la-conmebol-libertadores-2025/|title=Fixture de Cuartos de Final de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores Quarter-Finals Fixture|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=22 August 2025|access-date=22 August 2025|language=es}}</ref><ref name="QF fixture pdf">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/Fixture_Cuartos-de-Final_CONMEBOL-Libertadores-2025_v22.08.2025.pdf|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2025 {{!}} PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión 22.08.2025|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=22 August 2025|access-date=22 August 2025}}</ref>

==Semi-finals==
===Summary===
The first legs were played on 22 and 23 October, and the second legs were played on 29 and 30 October 2025.<ref name="SF fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fixture-de-semifinales-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2025/|title=Fixture de Semifinales de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores Semi-Finals Fixture|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=27 September 2025|access-date=27 September 2025|language=es}}</ref><ref name="SF fixture pdf">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Fixture_Semifinales_CONMEBOL-Libertadores-2025_v26.09.2025.pdf|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2025 {{!}} PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión 26.09.2025|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=27 September 2025|access-date=27 September 2025}}</ref>
